name: B10-0146/2026 (PPE) – Four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament marks four years since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. It restates its support for Ukraine's independence and its right to defend itself, and says Russia's aggression must fail. It calls for more EU action: tougher sanctions, a 90 billion euro loan for Ukraine, military support including air defence, and no lifting of sanctions before a peace deal. It also demands that Russia stop attacking civilians and return deported Ukrainian children.

- The report is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.
- It calls for a 90 billion euro loan, more sanctions and military aid to Ukraine.
- EU governments and the Commission are asked to act on these calls.
